query:
UPDATE restaurants
           SET name              = COALESCE($1, name),
               address           = CASE WHEN $2::boolean THEN $3::text ELSE address END,
               timezone          = COALESCE($4, timezone),
               default_language  = COALESCE($5, default_language),
               formatting_locale = COALESCE($6, formatting_locale),
               updated_at        = now()
